title: Sudden arm weakness and slurred speech
goal: You are the clinician. Assess a possible stroke: establish the exact onset time, test face, arm, and speech, and confirm urgent emergency escalation.
opening: Something is wrong. My face feels funny and my arm will not move the way it should.

disclosures.response: It started about forty minutes ago, right after I got up from the couch.
My wife wrote down that I was completely normal at 3:15. It is now about 3:55.
My mouth feels like it is drooping on the right side. I can see it in the mirror.
I can barely lift my right arm, and my right leg feels heavy and clumsy.
My words are coming out slurred. My wife says I sound drunk, but I have not had anything to drink.
My vision is a little blurry on one side, and I felt dizzy when I stood up.
I have high blood pressure, and I take a blood thinner for atrial fibrillation. I also smoked for years.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes rapport under time pressure.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself quickly and keep the patient calm while you assess.

metrics.name: Onset time (last known well)
metrics.rationale: Establishes the exact time the patient was last normal, which drives the emergency response.
metrics.coaching_hint: Pin down the exact onset time: 'When were you last completely normal?'

metrics.name: Facial droop assessment
metrics.coaching_hint: Check the face: 'Can you smile for me — any drooping?'

metrics.name: Arm and leg weakness
metrics.coaching_hint: Test limb strength: 'Raise both arms and hold them up — does one drift down?'

metrics.name: Speech and language
metrics.rationale: Tests for slurred speech or trouble finding or understanding words.
metrics.coaching_hint: Assess speech: 'Repeat a short phrase — any slurring or trouble finding words?'

metrics.name: Urgent escalation
metrics.rationale: Recognizes the time-critical presentation and activates emergency evaluation.
metrics.coaching_hint: Recognize urgency: 'This needs emergency activation right now.'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Confirms the emergency plan with the patient and any bystanders.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the emergency plan and check understanding before ending.
